brief:
Demonstrators rallied across the globe to mark the October 7 attack, according to Al Jazeera English, calling for an end to Israeli operations in Gaza and the West Bank. Streets filled with protesters demanding a ceasefire as the one-year anniversary of the attack drew international attention to the ongoing conflict.

The demonstrations reflected growing pressure for diplomatic resolution to the violence that has gripped the region since October 7.
dek: Demonstrators have taken to streets across the world to demand an end to Israeli attacks on Gaza and the West Bank.
title: Protesters worldwide demand Gaza ceasefire on October 7 anniversary
